sn27.10:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso uppakileso || la || Yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu pañcasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti || nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || || Kilesa-saṃyuttam || || Tassuddānaṃ || ||
sn27.10:2.0: Cakkhu Rūpañca Viññāṇaṃ || Phasso ca Vedanāya ca || Saññāya Cetanā Taṇhā || Dhātu Khandhena te dasā ti || || Ekaṃ
